description: This script generates C++ header and source files for mapping GLenum values to strings for the ANGLE project. It reads XML files describing OpenGL enums and produces code for enum-to-string conversions.

methods.name: dump_value_to_string_mapping
methods.description: Creates a string mapping of GLenum values to their string representations, filtering and sorting enum pairs.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates reading XML data, generating enum mappings, and writing header and source files.
